sources.name: models.dev (AI model providers)
sources.license: MIT (models.dev data); each provider has its own terms
sources.note: Every provider in api.json. summary = the provider page's own meta description when readable, otherwise a line built from models.dev data. Korean lines (summaryKo) for the big providers are written by 코드잇소. Per-model facts (prices per 1M tokens, limits, modalities, dates) are copied as-is into data/catalog-models/models-dev.json with the collection date (D141); freeTierQuote is a sentence copied as-is from the official pricing page; limitsUrl is the official rate-limit / usage-tier page, hand-checked on limitsCheckedAt and checked alive on every import. metrics.downloads = npm weekly downloads of the official SDK or of the provider's own AI SDK package (named by models.dev, or @ai-sdk/<provider id> when that package exists), whichever is larger (preview.downloadsOf). metrics.siteRank = global Chrome UX Report rank bucket of the item's site (1000, 5000, 10000, 50000, 100000, 500000, 1000000; Chrome UX Report top lists (CC BY 4.0, via github.com/zakird/crux-top-lists), 2026-10), set only when the item has no other metric. Used only for sorting.
